label: filesystem free-space write limit
type: an off-by-default cluster setting that makes Couchbase Server refuse writes to buckets once the filesystem falls below a configured free-space threshold; set through Advanced Data Settings in the Web Console or the corresponding REST endpoint.
evidence: This option is off by default. When selected, Couchbase Server prevents writes to buckets when the filesystem free space falls below the limit.
This limit is set through the Advanced Data Settings in the Couchbase Server Web Console.
note: A protection that is off by default, and one an operator would reasonably assume is on. Round 26 promoted three settings of this shape (with security:session-management and durability:preserve-durable-writes-setting); the general-settings.md page is the densest single source of them in the corpus, and none of them exist in the reference tree at all.
